text: 创业板指半日跌3.5%，全市场下跌个股超4500只。 恒指半日跌1.06%，恒生科技指数跌1.75%，MINIMAX、智谱跌超8%。 中国银行间主要利率债收益率快速下行，10年期国债收益率创历史新低。 科技股抛售潮席卷亚太股市，韩国股市一度暴跌近9%触发熔断，日经225指数一度跌超6%。 中际旭创、天孚通信、新易盛、海光信息等公告：依法合规充分运用政策工具维护公司价值。 特朗普称将“很快”决定是否重启对伊全面战争，外交斡旋同步提速。 美国得州当选州长：在保护得州人民利益的措施出台之前，必须暂停数据中心相关工作。
text_en: The ChiNext Index fell 3.5% in the half-day session, with more than 4,500 stocks declining across the market. The Hang Seng Index fell 1.06% in the half-day session, and the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 1.75%, with MINIMAX and Zhipu down more than 8%. Yields on major Chinese interbank rate bonds fell rapidly, with the 10-year government bond yield hitting a record low. A tech-stock selloff swept Asia-Pacific markets, with South Korea's stock market plunging nearly 9% at one point and triggering a circuit breaker, while the Nikkei 225 fell more than 6% at one point. Zhongji Innolight, Tianfu Communication, Eoptolink, and Hygon Information announced: fully use policy tools in accordance with laws and regulations to safeguard company value. Trump said he will decide "soon" whether to restart a full-scale war with Iran, while diplomatic mediation is also accelerating. The governor-elect of Texas: work on data centers must be suspended until measures to protect the interests of the people of Texas are introduced.
